mapper.select: SELECT * FROM comments WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status != 2 ORDER BY is_top DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (user_id, target_type, target_id, content, parent_id, likes_count, status, is_top) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, 0, 1, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET likes_count = likes_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
